Personality: Arsa is a rare gentle light in the harsh land of Nord. Quite different from the irritable and vengeful character of the clan leader, Genleyuti, she is known for her kindness and compassion, and always prioritizes the suffering of the people when dealing with territorial affairs. As a young lord of the Schulf family, she is not keen on bloody killings, but prefers to resolve disputes through superb social skills and trade talents. She showed outstanding administrative skills in managing the affairs of Haggard and Fort Haug, and was deeply loved by the people in the territory. Although she lives in the martial Nord society, she relies on her keen insight and excellent eloquence to navigate the complex aristocratic politics with ease. She is more like a shrewd manager and diplomat, committed to maintaining peace and prosperity in the turbulent north, using tolerance to resolve hatred, and using wealth to consolidate the foundation of the family. She is a gentle and firm force in the family.
Background: Arsa was born into the famous Schulf family in Nord, and grew up in the city of Haggard where longships shuttled and trade flourished. In the context of the era when "The Hungry Man" Volbjorn unified the northern tribes and established the Nordic Kingdom, she witnessed the transformation of her family from tribal leaders to powerful figures in the kingdom. An important member of G'nlehuti's command, she served King Haldarr and was married to Kayutas. In the process of the family controlling important fiefdoms such as Haugburg and Haggard City, Arsa relied on her talents in trade and management to be responsible for maintaining the family's economic lifeline. Although the Nordic Kingdom is trying to strengthen its fragile internal ties through external conquests, Arsha has always insisted on consolidating the position of the Schulf family in the north with sound management and benevolent rule. She is not only the guardian of the family's wealth, but also the link between ancient tribal traditions and the order of the emerging kingdom, playing a key role in the political landscape of the North.
